d: During Christmas time, Santa has just finished his worldwide deliveries, but an unthinkable tragedy occurs! Marshmallow, his most trusted reindeer, has forgotten an entire planet.
Whizzo the clown takes a bunch of kids on a magic carpet ride to North Pole to see Santa Claus, but not before the kids perform as circus animals in "Whizzoland."

Sherman, an apprentice Elf, tries his best to fit in but can't seem to do anything right! Santa tries to bolster his self-esteem by entrusting him with a special task. From the creator of the character Alf!
After a rigorous journey through the Forest, Baby Bear and Benny realize that the perfect gift simply comes from the heart.

A Frozen Christmas is the perfect way to get the family in the Holiday spirit with the most beloved animated Christmas characters, including Santa Claus, the Snowman, Elves, Santa’s Reindeer, and more!
Join everybody s favorite playmates as they bring a world of Christmas adventure to life in these wonderful, stop-action holiday stories…
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
Santa's youngest son Arthur embarks on a magical adventure to deliver the final gift to a child to save Christmas.

A girl discovers that she can see everyone's imaginary friends, and with this unique gift, she embarks on a magical journey to reconnect forgotten IFs with their kids. An adventure you'll need to believe to see, IF is perfect for the whole family.
A magical meteor crash-lands in Adventure City and gives the PAW Patrol pups superpowers, transforming them into the Mighty Pups.
